records.name: IndependentSounds
records.summary: A Philadelphia festival of opera and orchestra music that puts on performances for ticket buyers each year.
records.what_you_do: Buy tickets to the festival, join the email list to hear about shows, or browse the archive of past performances. The site lists no classes or volunteer roles.

schedule.text: Annual festival, with the 2026 season on sale now. Exact dates are not shown on the page.

cost.text: Tickets are sold for each performance; prices are not shown on the page read

first_step.how: Join the email list on the site, then buy a ticket for the 2026 festival
first_step.basis: Performances are open to the public with tickets; the page does not describe any membership

records.notes: Interest tag is the closest fit for opera and orchestra; there is no classical music tag. The only dated item is a 2026 festival with no month shown, so status is probably_active, not active.

records.name: Indonesian Lantern Media LLC
records.notes: An online news and media business for the Indonesian diaspora across the United States. It publishes articles, runs an app and has no in-person or Philadelphia program, so it is not a community group. Contact listed: editorial@indonesianlantern.com. Newest dated posts are September and October 2026.

records.name: InLiquid
records.summary: A Philadelphia art group with a gallery at Crane Arts that shows local artists' work, runs an online magazine and posts calls for artists.
records.what_you_do: Visit the gallery and openings for free, come to artist receptions, or apply for artist membership and submit work to its calls. The site lists no classes or volunteer roles.

schedule.text: Gallery open Wednesday to Saturday, noon to 6 pm; shows and receptions run through fall 2026

cost.text: Gallery visits are listed as open to the public; prices for other events not stated

first_step.how: Visit the Crane Arts gallery on a Wednesday to Saturday afternoon, or RSVP for an opening such as the October 23 to November 28 show
first_step.basis: Shows and receptions are open to the public; artist membership needs an application

records.notes: Email is not published; the site uses a contact form. Office hours are Monday to Friday, 10 am to 6 pm, by appointment only. Tag fit is approximate; the gallery shows photography, glass and other media.

records.name: InterAct Theatre Company
records.summary: A Philadelphia theater company that stages new and contemporary plays at The Drake, and takes in new scripts from playwrights.
records.what_you_do: Buy single tickets or a season subscription to see the plays, or submit a script to the company. The site does not list classes or volunteer roles such as ushering.

schedule.text: Season runs through spring 2027; the next show, This Much I Know, runs October 30 to November 22, 2026

first_step.how: Buy a single ticket for This Much I Know (October 30 to November 22, 2026) through the box office, or sign up for the newsletter
first_step.basis: Anyone can buy a ticket; the company is professional rather than a volunteer group

records.notes: Playwright submissions and the Lobstah Lab development program exist, but no details were read. The 2025 press items are older than the season listings.

records.name: Inti Media
records.summary: A Latine-led newsroom in Philadelphia that makes news in English, Spanish and Portuguese, podcasts and films, and runs free community events like a Spanish-language film class and a dance night.
records.what_you_do: Come to free public events such as the Queer Afro Latin Dance, take the Spanish-language film course, or send a story idea through the Pitch In page. Donations and newsletter sign-up are also listed.

schedule.text: October 2026 events: Spanish film course on October 13, 20 and 27; Queer Afro Latin Dance on October 25 at FDR Park (it meets monthly at Mercado Latino)

cost.text: The dance lesson is free with no RSVP; the film course cost is not listed

first_step.how: Come to the free Queer Afro Latin Dance on October 25, 2026 at FDR Park; no RSVP is needed
first_step.basis: The dance is free and open to LGBTQ+ people with no RSVP; the page does not say beginners are specifically welcome

records.notes: Community programs listed on the site include Empowering Madres Latinas and the Cineclub en Espanol; both are named but not checked. The Instagram handle is @newsbyintimedia. The first URL tried, inti-media.org, did not resolve; the correct site is www.intimedia.org.

records.name: New Africa Center (Islamic Cultural Preservation and Information Council)
records.summary: An archive and cultural center in West Philadelphia that shares the history of African American Muslims through exhibits, lectures and youth camps.
records.what_you_do: Attend free lectures, tours, exhibits and performances, take part in the monthly community meal, or send a child to a break or summer camp for ages 6 to 13. The site describes no volunteer program.

schedule.text: Community meal on the 1st and 3rd Saturday of each month (stated on the site, not dated); camps during winter, spring and summer breaks

cost.text: Lectures are listed as free; camp fees and membership levels are $100 to $500 a year as a membership option

first_step.how: Email icpic@rcn.com or call (267) 957-5971 to ask about the next free lecture or the next break camp, or visit Wednesday to Saturday, 1 to 6 pm
first_step.basis: Lectures and events are open to the public, but the newest dated item on the site is from 2021, so current availability is not confirmed

records.notes: Dated items on the site run from 2021 and earlier (the 2025 is the copyright year, which is not evidence). The meal and camp schedule is stated without dates, so status is unknown rather than active. Confirm with the center before listing as current. Hours are Wednesday to Saturday, 1 to 6 pm.

records.name: Kosoko Performance Studio
records.notes: The website belongs to one artist who runs paid creative coaching, retreats and a private intake form. No public class, membership or volunteer program was found on the pages read (home, offerings). Two linked pages, Current and Upcoming and Join the Circle, were not read. Recheck if the studio later publishes a public class schedule.

records.name: KyoDaiko
records.summary: A community taiko drumming group that teaches classes to beginners and experienced players and performs at festivals and fundraisers.
records.what_you_do: Take a beginner or experienced taiko class, come to public performances, or book the group for a festival or event. The site lists no volunteer roles.

schedule.text: Classes are on the classes page (The Fundamentals class returns in September 2026); performing at the Barnes Art Ball on October 16, 2026

locations.label: Address on contact page (practice space not confirmed)

cost.text: Class fees are on the classes page, not read

first_step.how: Email kyodaiko.info@gmail.com to ask about the next Fundamentals class, which the site says is returning
first_step.basis: The site offers beginner classes, says it welcomes new members, and points to a classes page to start

records.notes: Instagram handle is @KyoDaiko; the URL was not confirmed. Guest performances with the Savoy Theatre Co are listed but not checked. The Greater Philadelphia Cultural Alliance Flex Fund and Cultural Fund support are noted with no date. Weekly commitment is inferred from the class structure, so confirm on the classes page.

records.name: LensBright Initiative
records.summary: An arts nonprofit that gives high school students in West Philadelphia film and photography equipment, weekly mentoring and a finished project each year.
records.what_you_do: Students work with university mentors on a film or photography project in a weekly after-school program. The site could not be opened, so how to join is not confirmed.

schedule.text: Weekly after-school program; the 2025 to 26 cycle ran January to June 2026

cost.text: Equipment is supplied to students; fees are not stated

first_step.how: Ask the Penn and Philly team (pennandphilly@upenn.edu, as listed on their page) how students and schools can join the next cycle

records.notes: The group's own site, lensbright.org, returned a TLS error (certificate expired) on both HTTPS and HTTP, so nothing on it was read. The facts above come from a February 2026 University of Pennsylvania page and a search result. Status rests on that February 2026 post. Recheck the group's site when it is back.

records.name: Lightbox Film Center
records.summary: A nonprofit cinema in South Philadelphia that shows repertory, nonfiction, experimental and international films and restores old films.
records.what_you_do: Buy a ticket to a screening, join as a member, or donate. The page lists no classes or volunteer roles.

schedule.text: Screenings at Bok Auditorium on Sundays and Wednesdays through October 2026 (the page lists October dates without a year)

cost.text: General $14, student and senior $12, members $5, ACCESS and EBT cardholders $2

first_step.how: Buy a ticket for any screening at the box office or online through Ticketleap
first_step.basis: Screenings are open to anyone with a ticket and no application is needed

records.notes: Public way in is attending screenings; the group lists group rates by email. Address is the rideshare drop-off point given on the site; the visitor entrance is at 821 Dudley Street. Membership benefits are not described. Became an independent nonprofit in 2024.

records.name: Lightning Rod Special
records.notes: A performance company that makes original theater, with shows that have played Philadelphia Fringe. It has no public classes, membership or volunteer program. Its only public way in is attending shows, which a theater company does not count as a community group. Latest dated item: an Edinburgh Fringe run in 2026 (year only). Board inquiries go to a company address.

records.name: Mad Beatz Philly
records.summary: A percussion education group that teaches drumline to students at schools around Philadelphia and trains young people to become music teachers.
records.what_you_do: Schools can book weekly drumline classes for students of all levels, and aspiring teachers can train with the group while earning pay for teaching work. The group also books drumline performances.

schedule.text: Weekly drumline classes at participating schools, all skill levels; performance readiness in about 3 months

locations.label: Philadelphia school sites (8 sites listed as a count, none named)

first_step.how: Call 267-872-4942 (Monday to Friday, 8 am to 6 pm) or use the site contact form to ask about classes at your school
first_step.basis: Classes run through schools and bookings, so an individual student's way in is not clear from the site

records.notes: The site promotes 2026 bookings and has a 2026 footer, but no dated class, event or news item was found, so status is probably_active. No street address is published; only Philadelphia, PA. The site lists the 2013 founding and training numbers from 2014 to 2019. Instrument tag is the closest fit for drumline.

notes: Read 12 groups in the batch. Verdicts: 9 publish, 3 not_a_group (Indonesian Lantern Media, Kosoko Performance Studio, Lightning Rod Special). The Inti Media URL inti-media.org did not resolve; the real site is www.intimedia.org. LensBright's own site is blocked by an expired certificate, so its record rests on a February 2026 UPenn post and is low confidence. New Africa Center's dated items run to 2021, so its status is unknown. Leads with a website were not fetched because the batch pages gave no own URL for most of them, and I did not guess URLs; the URLs shown above on leads are the batch pages they were found on, not their own sites. Budget: 1 of 2 WebSearch used; 17 WebFetch calls used of 60.
